label: Bedside / Staff nurse
mission: Become the nurse who brings governed AI to the bedside — without letting the bedside cost me my health or my people.
sub: Maya Reyes, RN, CCRN · night shift, cardiac ICU · 11 years in · mother of two · building something on the side. Your agents work across all of it — not just the twelve hours the hospital sees.
seasonBody: You chose depth this season: finish the CMC, steady the house, and let the venture idle on purpose. Nothing here is behind — it is sequenced.
seasonMeta: Week 9 of 16 · you set this on 12 June · next review 2 September

actions.title: Protect the two nights before your next stretch
actions.why: You have three twelves starting Thursday. The last two stretches you went in already short on sleep, and both weeks after them show your lowest honored-commitment counts.
actions.cost: 2 minutes to block · Florence will not touch it again

actions.title: File the certification reimbursement
actions.why: Roughly $740 across two dated items, and the window closes 3 September. Scribe has the form filled from your own records — it needs your eyes and your send.
actions.cost: 6 minutes · waits at a human gate

actions.title: Twenty minutes on pharm, while it is quiet
actions.why: Pharm just overtook hemodynamics as your weakest blueprint area. Scholar has eleven cards queued from your own wrong answers, not a generic bank.

health.signal: Four of the last seven nights under six hours. Your own line, not ours.
health.detail: You wrote “sleep is the one I trade first” in your SOUL file in June. This is the third month it has trended down. Florence has drafted nothing here — Health is the one sphere she cannot act in without you asking.

family.signal: Eleven protected evenings held. Zero cancelled for a shift swap.
family.detail: Two standing blocks — Sunday dinner, Thursday pickup — have survived nine straight weeks, including your two hardest stretches. This is the thing that is working.

career.signal: Unit council seat accepted through December. Preceptor load steady at two.
career.detail: The work itself — your role, your unit, your practice. Nothing here has drifted, which in the season you chose is correct rather than a flat line to fix. Your license and standing are held separately, above.

learning.signal: CMC blueprint 62% covered. Weakest area moved from hemodynamics to pharm.
learning.detail: Scholar runs spaced repetition against your own weak-point log. At this pace the blueprint closes three weeks before your test date — the buffer you asked for.

finance.signal: Certification reimbursement window closes in 23 days. Nothing filed yet.
finance.detail: Two dated items sit unclaimed: the CMC exam fee and last year’s conference travel. Roughly $740, and the door closes 3 September. Filing is a form, not a decision.

creative.signal: Nine notes captured, three promoted to the vault, one became a skill.
creative.detail: Your capture-to-keep ratio holds at about one in three, which is healthy. The handoff-script idea has been re-noted four times — that usually means it wants to be built.

service.signal: Two Lamp Huddles attended. One new grad mentored weekly since May.
service.detail: Mentorship is the most consistent line in this domain for four months. You have never once rescheduled it, which says more than the number does.

business.signal: Paused by you on 12 June until the CMC is behind you. Resumes 2 September.
business.detail: A chosen pause, logged with an end date — not neglect. Nothing here will be surfaced as a signal until 2 September, so it stops competing for your attention.

momentum.label: returned to you this month by work your agents carried and you reviewed.
momentum.note: Estimated from your own logged task times before and after each skill file went live. Your estimate, not ours — edit any of it.
momentum.caption: the flywheel caught around week 5

risks.what: A screenshot pasted in a hurry
risks.guard: Import refuses on PHI indicators and a nightly lint sweeps everything already stored. The system catches it.
Refused at every tier, in every sphere, including Green. The system catches it.

risks.what: Reaching for an ungoverned window instead
risks.guard: No governed system can reach a chat window it does not run. This one is yours to keep — it is the reason the rails are worth having.

signals.title: Sleep is trending down for a third month
signals.body: Not an alarm — a pattern you told the system to watch for. Two protected nights before Thursday would break it.

signals.title: A dated window closes on 3 September
signals.body: Certification reimbursement, roughly $740, still unfiled. The only item here with a hard deadline.

signals.title: Your library has 14 pages with no provenance
signals.body: A library nobody curates is a garbage dump with great search. Twenty minutes of the librarian ritual clears it.

signals.title: ACLS renews in 74 days, with no class booked
signals.body: The only item on your standing with a date and no plan attached. Everything else is current or in progress.

opps.title: CMC test date opens for November
opps.body: Your blueprint coverage projects a three-week buffer if the current pace holds.

opps.title: Dr. Ng asked about the handoff idea
opps.body: She raised it unprompted in June. Your notes say you meant to follow up and did not.
opps.when: Six weeks cold — still warm enough

opps.title: Handoff-script skill, noted four times
opps.body: The same idea keeps returning to your capture inbox. That is usually the signal to build it.

opps.title: One skill is clean enough to share
opps.body: Your shift-recovery checklist has no PHI, no employer content, and no secrets.

agents.scope: All spheres, read-only outside Health. Drafts freely; sends nothing.

agents.scope: Learning sphere only. Reads your weak-point log; writes to the study queue.

agents.scope: Creativity and Business spheres. No calendar access, no outbound send.
